study_type_evidence.quote: Kunming mice (n = 18 for Di-GLP-1, n = 21 for liraglutide (chemical), n = 24 for Lip-Di-GLP-1) were fasted overnight
The GLP-1 receptor activation potencies of Di-GLP-1 and Lip-Di-GLP-1 were evaluated using a pervious described method using HEK293 cells
Rat pancreatic INS-1 cells were used to determine the in vitro toxicity of Di-GLP-1 and Lip-Di-GLP-1.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: normal male Kunming mice, 20-28 g (PK, IPGTT, gastric emptying)
in_vivo_species.quote: Normal male Kunming mice (20-28 g) were purchased from Qinglongshan Animal Breeding Farm (Nanjing, China).

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: BKS.Cg-Dock7m+/+Leprdb/J (db/db), male, 7-8 weeks (efficacy, toxicity, chronic dosing)
in_vivo_species.quote: BKS.Cg-Dock7m+/+Leprdb/J (db/db) mice (male, 7-8 weeks) were purchased from Model Animal Research Center of Nanjing University

in_vitro_detail: GLP-1R activation potency (EC50) measured by HTRF cAMP assay in HEK293 cells stably expressing GLP-1R; cytotoxicity assessed by MTT in rat pancreatic INS-1 cells at 10, 100 and 1000 nM.

agents.name: Lip-Di-GLP-1 (lipidated dimerized GLP-1)
agents.sequence_source: Body states the construction only in words: 'the Ala8 in GLP-1 was replaced with Gly ... an additional Cys was introduced to the C-terminal of GLP-1, and Gly8-Cys31-GLP-1 was firstly constructed', then coupled with bis-maleimide amine and activated palmitic acid. No one-letter sequence is printed in the body.
agents.chemical_identifier: prepared from Gly8-Cys31-GLP-1, bis-maleimide amine (Mw = 546.3) and NHS-activated palmitic acid
agents.group_n: n = 24 total animals for the PK arm (mice sacrificed at each timepoint); Figure 1F caption states means ± SD, n = 3
agents.group_n_quote: Kunming mice (n = 18 for Di-GLP-1, n = 21 for liraglutide (chemical), n = 24 for Lip-Di-GLP-1) were fasted overnight
agents.dose: 50 nmol/kg (PK); 10, 25 and 100 nmol/kg (efficacy); 500 nmol/kg twice daily (one-week toxicity)
agents.dose_route_quote: 50 nmol kg-1 of liraglutide (chemical), Di-GLP-1 and Lip-Di-GLP-1 were s.c. administrated.
agents.auc: AUCinf = 7456.6 ± 564.4 (units not stated in the body)
agents.pk_quote: the t1/2 of Lip-Di-GLP-1 (7.0 ± 0.7 h) was 1.8 times higher than liraglutide (3.9 ± 0.3 h), and its AUCinf value (7456.6 ± 564.4) was 2.8 times greater than that of liraglutide (2693.6 ± 175.5). The body calls the parameter only 't1/2' with no phase label, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and neither an absorption nor an elimination half-life is asserted. Full PK parameters are referred to 'Table S3 (see ESI)', which is not part of the body; Cmax and tmax therefore do not appear in the body. AUCinf units are not printed in the body.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - PK profiles of Di-GLP-1 and Lip-Di-GLP-1

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: (F) PK profiles of Lip-Di-GLP-1 in Kunming mice. Means ± SD, n = 3.
concentration_time_figure.note: Plasma concentration versus time after a single 50 nmol/kg s.c. dose. The figure caption names only Lip-Di-GLP-1, although the Results text states PK was measured for Di-GLP-1, Lip-Di-GLP-1 and liraglutide (chemical) and refers the full parameter table to Table S3 in the ESI, which is outside the body. Figure 3D shows plasma paracetamol concentrations over time from the gastric-emptying probe test, not test-article PK.

bioanalytical_method: LC-MS/MS of plasma; PK parameters calculated with BAPP 2.2 (China Pharmaceutical University)
bioanalytical_quote: Plasma was obtained using the above described method and immediately frozen until analysis via LC-MS/MS using a previous described method.
notes: The body reports t1/2 and AUCinf only; NO Cmax and NO tmax appear anywhere in the body, because the full PK parameter set is deferred to Table S3 in the Electronic Supplementary Information. AUCinf values (7456.6 ± 564.4; 2693.6 ± 175.5; 1637.3 ± 39.3) are printed without units in the body and are recorded verbatim on that basis. The half-life is labelled only 't1/2' with no phase, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and both half_life_absorption and half_life_elimination are left 'not reported' - the paper does not fit or report a two-phase model. Group-size discrepancy: Methods state n = 18/21/24 total animals (destructive sampling, mice sacrificed at each of 8 timepoints), while the Figure 1F caption states n = 3, i.e. 3 mice per timepoint; both are recorded. Sequences: the body describes the construct in words (Gly8-Cys31-GLP-1 plus bis-maleimide amine plus palmitic acid) but never prints a one-letter sequence, so all sequences are 'not reported'; the sequences in the PEPLIFE2 header are database metadata and were not used. Curation rule applied: procedural probe and challenge substances are documented here rather than listed as agents - paracetamol (100 mg/kg orally, plasma levels measured by LC-MS/MS as a gastric-emptying probe) and the intraperitoneal glucose challenge (2 g/kg in Kunming mice, 1 g/kg in db/db mice). The published year field in the file header (2019) conflicts with the PMID vintage; not an extraction field.
